answer: Graded work pays from escrow, and each identity gets one submission slot per epoch. A fresh nonce goes into every submission, so a replayed answer is rejected before scoring. Escrow releases only on a signed grade, and a failed audit returns the funds. A farm of 1,000 identities needs 1,000 slots and 1,000 nonces per epoch, each carrying the same failed-grade risk. The jetty narrows to one lane, and the nebula of clones has no meadow left to feed on.
